purpose: Rebase the old 1943/Jan-1944 Bay-entry surface reinforcement gate after HAILSTONE, CATCHPOLE, the 3-Feb carrier battle and western naval-air redeployments.
old_rule_problem: Earlier planning language could be read as if any Eastern Fleet entry into the Bay automatically opened heavy-cruiser reinforcement. That is too coarse for the March Branch state.

new_distinctions.Bay_presence: RN heavy ships operating anywhere in the Bay is an intelligence/alert event only.
new_distinctions.Andaman_Bengal_threat: Requires a fresh track plus an east/northeast vector, repeated sweeps, or strike/support geometry against Port Blair, Andaman sea lanes, Akyab/Chittagong/Patenga or Japanese coastal LOCs.
new_distinctions.weapon_quality: Requires fresh air/submarine/visual recontact; COMINT or general sortie inference alone cannot launch a surface intercept.

surface_release_policy.Oyodo_group: May raise readiness and reposition within Singapore-Lingga/Penang-Sabang support axis on credible cues, but does not sortie blind into the Bay.
surface_release_policy.Suzuya_Kumano_or_equivalent_CA: NO_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE. Reassess only after Andaman/Bengal threat is established and Central-Pacific/mobile-fleet opportunity cost is explicitly accepted.
surface_release_policy.battlefleet_or_carriers: NO-GO for this gate; requires a separate strategic crisis decision.

INITIAL_08Mar_application.RN_state: KNOWN_IN_GENERAL_AT_CEYLON; fresh sortie track absent at T24.
INITIAL_08Mar_application.geographic_assessment: Historical/branch INITIAL axis is west-central Bay, not an Andaman approach at this point.
